title: Sana'o'in gargajiya
description: Ten stories about traditional crafts: a boy learning smithing from his uncle, a broom maker who ends a quarrel between neighbours, a barber-surgeon trained by a nurse, a tailor and a rich customer's five gowns, a saddle maker's apprentice at the Sallah Durbar, a Fulani woman who makes fura, a herbalist and a fake healer's eye medicine, a Qur'anic teacher who makes his own boards and ink, a hunter with his hawk, and a coral-bead seller in Maiduguri.

lessons.title: Maƙerin ƙauye
lessons.summary: In the school holidays Ɗanbirni stays with his paternal uncle Malam Gwadabe, a village blacksmith near Katsina: he learns to light the fire with matches, fans it with the bellows, watches broken hoes mended, hears the proverb about the sickle hidden in the turban, burns his heel when a spark also burns a sack to ashes, and makes his first sickle.
lessons.text:
Ɗanbirni ɗan shekara goma sha huɗu ne, kuma yana zaune a Katsina tare da iyayensa. Da aka yi hutun makaranta, mahaifinsa ya kai shi wurin baffansa, Malam Gwadabe, a wani ƙauye kusa da birnin. Malam Gwadabe yana sana'ar ƙira, kamar mahaifinsa da kakansa. Mahaifin Ɗanbirni ya ce masa, "Ka zauna da baffanka, ka koyi wani abu da hannunka, ba da littafi kawai ba."

Tun kafin rana ta fito, ake jin amon guduma daga wurin ƙirar Malam Gwadabe. Amon yana tashi har ƙarshen ƙauyen. Ɗanbirni ya tambayi baffansa, "Baffa, amon nan ba ya damun maƙwabta?" Malam Gwadabe ya yi dariya, ya ce, "Sun saba da shi. Ranar da ba su ji amon guduma ba, sai su zo su tambaye ni ko ba ni da lafiya."

Aikin farko da baffansa ya ba shi shi ne kunna wuta. Ya miƙa masa akwatin ashana. Ɗanbirni ya kunna ashana ta farko, sai iska ta kashe ta. Ya kunna ta biyu, ita ma ta mutu. Sai baffansa ya nuna masa yadda ake kare ashana da tafin hannu, kuma ta uku ta kama.

Bayan wutar ta kama, sai aikin rura ta. A gefen wutar akwai wasu jakunkunan fata guda biyu. Ɗanbirni ya zauna a gabansu, yana ɗaga su yana danna su, iska tana shiga cikin wutar. "Haka ake rura wuta," in ji baffansa. "Ka ci gaba da rura ta har gawayin ya yi ja kamar jini. Ƙarfe ba ya lanƙwasa sai a wuta mai ƙarfi."

Manoma suna ta zuwa da kayansu, domin damina ta kusa. Wani ya kawo fasassun fartanyoyi, wani kuma fasassun gatura. Malam Gwadabe ya ɗauki fasassun kayan ɗaya bayan ɗaya, ya saka su a wuta, sannan ya buga su da guduma har suka haɗe.

Sai wani tsoho ya kawo lauje. Lauje ƙaramar wuƙa ce mai lanƙwasa, wadda ake yanka ciyawa da ita. Malam Gwadabe ya wasa bakin laujen har ya yi kaifi. Da tsohon ya tafi, ya ce wa Ɗanbirni, "Hausawa suna cewa, 'akwai lauje cikin naɗi.' A da, wani yakan ɓoye lauje a cikin rawaninsa. Idan aka ce akwai lauje cikin naɗi, ana nufin akwai wani abu ɓoyayye a cikin lamarin."

Da rana ta yi, Ɗanbirni ya cire takalminsa saboda zafi. Ba da daɗewa ba, wani ɗan ƙarfe mai zafi ya yi tsalle daga wutar ya faɗi a kan diddigensa. Ya yi ihu. A daidai lokacin, wutar ta kama wani tsohon buhu a gefen ƙofa, kuma kafin su yi wani abu, buhun ya ƙone kurmus, sai toka kawai ta rage.

Baffansa ya zuba ruwan sanyi a diddigensa, ya ce, "Abin da ya sa mai ƙira ba ya cire takalmi ke nan. Da wannan buhun mutum ne, da ya ƙone kurmus."

Kafin hutun ya ƙare, Ɗanbirni ya ƙera ƙaramin lauje da hannunsa, ya kai wa mahaifinsa kyauta.

Tambayoyi:
Wane ne Malam Gwadabe?
Malam Gwadabe baffan Ɗanbirni ne, kuma yana sana'ar ƙira a wani ƙauye kusa da Katsina.
Ashana ta nawa ta kama?
Ashana ta uku ce ta kama, bayan baffansa ya nuna masa yadda ake kare ta da tafin hannu.
Me ake nufi da "akwai lauje cikin naɗi"?
Ana nufin akwai wani abu ɓoyayye a cikin lamarin.
Me ya faru da diddigen Ɗanbirni?
Wani ɗan ƙarfe mai zafi ya faɗi a kan diddigensa, domin ya cire takalminsa.
Me ya faru da tsohon buhun?
Wutar ta kama shi, kuma ya ƙone kurmus.

lessons.title: Tsintsiyar Gambiya
lessons.summary: In Zaria, the old broom maker Gambiya ties palm stalks two by two into brooms; a quarrel between the neighbours Zubairu and Shu'aibu over rainwater grows until the local government chairman comes to a meeting, where Gambiya, speaking gently, breaks a single stalk but no one can break the whole broom; the chairman cries 'Well done!' and the men welcome his plan for a drain.
lessons.text:
Gambiya tsohuwa ce mai shekaru saba'in, kuma tana zaune a wata tsohuwar unguwa a Zaria. Sana'arta ita ce yin tsintsiya, kuma ta gaji sana'ar daga mahaifiyarta. Kowace safiya takan zauna a ƙofar gidanta, ta zaɓi tsinken kaba masu ƙarfi, ta haɗa su bibbiyu, sannan ta ɗaure su da igiya har su zama tsintsiya.

A watan da ya wuce, wata husuma ta tashi tsakanin maƙwabta biyu na unguwar, Zubairu da Shu'aibu. Ruwan sama yana fita daga gidan Zubairu yana bi ta ƙofar gidan Shu'aibu. Shu'aibu ya ce ruwan yana lalata bangonsa, Zubairu kuma ya ce ruwa ba shi da wata hanya. Da farko maganar ƙarama ce, amma husumar ta yi ta girma. Matasan unguwar suka rabu biyu, wasu suna goyon bayan Zubairu, wasu na Shu'aibu.

Mai unguwa ya ga abin ya fi ƙarfinsa, sai ya kai ƙara wurin ciyaman na ƙaramar hukuma. Ciyaman ɗin, Alhaji Ɗanfari, mutum ne mai dattaku, wanda ba ya son hayaniya. Ya ce zai zo da kansa bayan sallar la'asar, domin a yi taro a ƙofar gidan mai unguwa.

Da la'asar ta yi, mutane suka taru. Ciyaman ya zauna a kan kujera, Zubairu a gefe guda, Shu'aibu a ɗaya gefen. Kowanne ya faɗi nasa, muryoyinsu suna ƙara tashi. Sai Gambiya ta tashi tana dogara da sanda, hannunta riƙe da tsintsiya guda.

Ta yi magana cikin tattausan harshe, kamar uwa tana magana da 'ya'yanta: "'Ya'yana, ku dube ni." Ta zare tsinke ɗaya daga cikin tsintsiyar, ta karya shi da yatsu biyu kawai. Sannan ta miƙa wa Zubairu tsintsiyar duka, ta ce, "Kai, karya wannan." Zubairu ya yi ƙoƙari da ƙarfinsa duka, amma tsintsiyar ba ta karye ba. Ta miƙa wa Shu'aibu, shi ma ya kasa.

"Kun gani," in ji Gambiya, har yanzu cikin tattausan murya. "Tsinke ɗaya, yaro ma zai karya shi. Amma idan tsinke da yawa sun haɗu, ko ƙato ba zai iya karya su ba. Shi ya sa kakanninmu suke cewa, mu zama tsintsiya maɗaurinki ɗaya. Unguwa ɗaya ce, ruwan sama ɗaya ne, kuma bangon da ruwa yake lalatawa duka namu ne. Husumar nan wawanci ne kawai, kuma wawanci ba ya gina unguwa."

Jama'a suka yi shiru. Sai ciyaman ya ce, "Yawwa! Abin da Gambiya ta faɗa shi ne gaskiya. Wannan shi ne dattaku." Ya ce ƙaramar hukuma za ta gina kwata a tsakanin gidajen biyu, domin ruwan ya samu hanya. Zubairu da Shu'aibu suka karɓi wannan shawara hannu bibbiyu, suka gaisa, suka yafe wa juna. Matasan da suka rabu biyu suka yi dariya, suka ce, "Yawwa, an gama!"

Washegari, ciyaman ya aiko a sayi tsintsiya ashirin daga wurin Gambiya domin ofishinsa. Ya ce, "Duk lokacin da ma'aikatan ofishin suka ga tsintsiya, za su tuna da dattakun wannan tsohuwa."

Tambayoyi:
Wace sana'a Gambiya take yi?
Sana'arta ita ce yin tsintsiya, kuma ta gaji sana'ar daga mahaifiyarta.
Me ya jawo husuma tsakanin Zubairu da Shu'aibu?
Ruwan sama yana fita daga gidan Zubairu yana bi ta ƙofar gidan Shu'aibu, yana lalata bangonsa.
Wurin wa mai unguwa ya kai ƙara?
Ya kai ƙara wurin ciyaman na ƙaramar hukuma, Alhaji Ɗanfari.
Me Gambiya ta yi da tsintsiyar?
Ta karya tsinke ɗaya da yatsu biyu, amma Zubairu da Shu'aibu sun kasa karya tsintsiyar duka.
Me ciyaman ya ce ƙaramar hukuma za ta yi?
Ya ce za ta gina kwata a tsakanin gidajen biyu, domin ruwan ya samu hanya.

lessons.title: Wanzamin kasuwa
lessons.summary: Malam Ɗangwari is a barber-surgeon in the Bauchi market, teaching his son Lukman cupping with a cow's horn; a government nurse, Malama Rumasa'u, comes to advise the barbers: one razor per person, the itching scalps caused by dirty razors, clean circumcision wounds and sending people with an ailment to hospital; Ɗangwari says they had already started boiling their razors.
lessons.text:
Malam Ɗangwari wanzami ne a babbar kasuwar Bauchi, kuma ɗansa Lukman yana koyon sana'ar a wurinsa. Kowace rana, a ƙarƙashin wata babbar bishiya a gefen kasuwa, Ɗangwari yakan aske kan maza, ya yi wa wasu ƙaho, ya kuma yi wa yara kaciya idan iyayensu suka kawo su.

Ƙaho shi ne aikin da Lukman ya fi so ya kalla. Wanzami yakan ɗan tsaga fatar bayan mutum da reza, sannan ya ɗora ƙahon saniya a kan wurin, ya tsotsa iska daga ƙaramin rami da ke ƙarshen ƙahon. Da zarar ya tsotsa iskar, ƙahon zai manne a jikin mutumin, jini kuma zai taru a cikinsa. Masu zuwa ƙaho galibi baligi ne, maza masu ciwon baya ko ciwon kai. Ɗangwari ba ya yi wa yaro ƙaho; a kullum yakan ce, "Sai mutum ya zama baligi."

Wata rana, wata ma'aikaciyar jinya daga asibitin gwamnati, Malama Rumasa'u, ta zo kasuwar domin ta yi wa masu aski horo. Ta tara su goma a ƙarƙashin bishiyar, Ɗangwari yana cikinsu, Lukman kuma yana zaune a bayan mahaifinsa.

Ta fara da cewa, "Ba mu zo domin mu hana ku sana'arku ba. Na zo ne domin shawartar ku a kan abubuwa uku."

"Na farko, tsafta. Wajibcin farko a kan kowane wanzami shi ne kada ya yi amfani da reza ɗaya ga mutane biyu. Ku tafasa kayanku a ruwan zafi kafin kowane aiki." Ɗangwari ya ɗaga hannu ya ce, "Malama, ai mun rigaya mun fara tafasa reza tun bara." Ta yi murmushi, ta ce, "Yawwa. To, tun da kun rigaya kun fara, ku koya wa sauran."

"Na biyu, ƙaiƙayi. Wasu maza sukan zo asibiti da ƙaiƙayin kai da ƙuraje bayan an aske su da reza mai datti. Ƙaiƙayin yakan fara kaɗan, amma idan mutum ya yi ta taɓa kansa, fatar takan ɓaci. Idan kuka ga mutum yana da ƙuraje a kansa, kada ku yi amfani da rezarsa a kan wani."

"Na uku, kaciya. Raunin kaciya a kan azzakarin yaro yana buƙatar tsafta sosai har ya warke. Idan yaro yana da wata lalura a azzakarinsa tun kafin kaciya, kamar ciwo, kada ku taɓa shi; ku kawo shi asibiti. Haka nan, idan babba yana da wata lalura, kamar ciwon sukari ko hawan jini, kada ku yi masa ƙaho; ku tura shi asibiti tukuna."

Wani tsoho ya ce, "Malama, mu kanmu muna shawartar mutane su je asibiti, amma ba sa zuwa." Ta ce, "Ai wajibcinku shi ne ku faɗa musu. Idan sun ƙi, kun yi naku."

Kafin ta tafi, ta ba kowannensu akwatin sababbin reza da ƙaramar tukunya ta tafasa kaya. Ɗangwari ya kalli Lukman ya yi dariya, ya ce, "Sana'a ba ta tsufa, sai idan mai yinta ya ƙi koyon sabon abu."

Tambayoyi:
Me wanzami yake tsotsa daga ƙahon?
Yana tsotsa iska daga ƙaramin rami da ke ƙarshen ƙahon.
Me ya sa Ɗangwari ba ya yi wa yaro ƙaho?
Domin yana ganin sai mutum ya zama baligi.
Me ya sa wasu maza suke zuwa asibiti da ƙaiƙayin kai?
Domin an aske su da reza mai datti.
Me ya kamata a yi idan yaro yana da wata lalura kafin kaciya?
Kada a taɓa shi, a kawo shi asibiti.
Me Malama Rumasa'u ta ba kowannensu?
Ta ba kowannensu akwatin sababbin reza da ƙaramar tukunya ta tafasa kaya.

lessons.title: Babbar rigar Alhaji
lessons.summary: Malam Ɗanhaladu, a Kaduna tailor who embroiders gowns by hand, gets a visit from the rich trader Alhaji Ɗansabo, whose driver parks in the middle of the road; Ɗansabo orders five gowns of luxury cloth, a high collar and a shortened sleeve; the tailor refuses to make his son shorts that do not cover the private parts; the credit card and the phone transfer hit a hitch; the apprentice calls the five gowns wastefulness.
lessons.text:
Malam Ɗanhaladu tela ne a Kaduna, kuma shagonsa ƙarami ne a cikin wata kasuwa mai cunkoso. Ba da inji kaɗai yake ɗinki ba; sananne ne wajen yin ado da zare a jikin babbar riga da hannunsa. Riga ɗaya takan ɗauke shi makonni uku, domin kowane zane da allura yake yinsa, ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Yaronsa Ilyasu yana zaune a gefensa, yana koyo.

Wata rana da yamma, wata baƙar mota ta tsaya a ƙofar kasuwar. Babu wurin fakin a wurin, sai direban ya yi fakin a tsakiyar hanya, kuma motocin da ke bayansa suka fara busa ƙaho. Wani mutum ya fito, sanye da farar babbar riga. Shi ne Alhaji Ɗansabo, wani babban ɗan kasuwa, tare da ɗansa Fu'ad.

Alhaji Ɗansabo ya ce, "Malam, za mu je ɗaurin aure a Abuja wata mai zuwa. Ina son ka ɗinka mini manyan riguna biyar, duk na kaya na alatu, masu tsada daga waje." Ilyasu bai taɓa ganin kaya na alatu irin wannan ba.

Malam Ɗanhaladu ya auna Alhaji. Sannan Alhaji ya ce, "Rigar ciki kuma ina son kwalarta ta ɗan yi tsawo, kamar ta Larabawa. Kuma tsohuwar rigata, hannunta ya yi tsawo; ka gajarta mini shi da yatsu biyu." Tela ya rubuta komai a cikin littafinsa: riguna biyar, kwala mai tsawo, a gajarta hannun tsohuwar riga.

Sai Fu'ad ya ce, "Malam, ni kuma ina son wando gajere, sama da gwiwa, domin wani biki da abokaina." Malam Ɗanhaladu ya yi murmushi, ya yi magana a hankali: "Ɗana, wando zan ɗinka maka, amma ba zan gajarta shi sama da gwiwa ba. A addininmu, tufafin namiji dole ne su rufe al'aura, daga cibiya zuwa gwiwa. Bari in ɗinka maka wani mai kyau wanda ya rufe al'aura." Fu'ad ya ɗan ji kunya, amma mahaifinsa ya ce, "Malam ya faɗi gaskiya."

Da aka zo biya, Alhaji ya fito da katin kiredit. Malam Ɗanhaladu ya ce, "Alhaji, ba ni da injin katin kiredit." Alhaji ya ce zai tura kuɗin ta waya, amma aka samu tangarda: sadarwa ba ta da ƙarfi a cikin kasuwar. Ya gwada sau uku, kowane lokaci tangarda iri ɗaya. A ƙarshe ya ce wa direbansa ya kawo kuɗi daga motar, ya biya rabin kuɗin a hannu.

A daidai lokacin, wani ɗan sanda ya zo ya ce wa direban, "Wannan ba wurin fakin ba ne! Ka ɗauke motar nan." Suka shiga mota suka tafi.

Da suka tafi, Ilyasu ya ce, "Malam, riguna biyar don ɗaurin aure ɗaya? Wannan ai almubazzaranci ne." Malam Ɗanhaladu ya ce, "Kuɗinsa ne, kuma aikinmu shi ne mu ɗinka. Amma gaskiya ne, Allah ba ya son almubazzaranci. Mu dai mu yi aikinmu da gaskiya." Sannan ya ɗauki allurarsa, ya fara zane na farko.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa riga ɗaya takan ɗauki Malam Ɗanhaladu makonni uku?
Domin yana yin kowane zane da allura da hannunsa.
Ina direban Alhaji Ɗansabo ya yi fakin?
Ya yi fakin a tsakiyar hanya, tun da babu wurin fakin.
Me Alhaji ya ce a yi wa tsohuwar rigarsa?
Ya ce a gajarta hannunta da yatsu biyu.
Me ya sa tela bai yarda ya ɗinka wa Fu'ad wando sama da gwiwa ba?
Domin tufafin namiji dole ne su rufe al'aura, daga cibiya zuwa gwiwa.
Me ya faru da Alhaji ya so ya biya ta waya?
An samu tangarda, domin sadarwa ba ta da ƙarfi a cikin kasuwar.

lessons.title: Sirdin Hawan Sallah
lessons.summary: Malam Jibo, a Kano leatherworker whose family has served the emir's palace for generations, repairs the horsemen's saddles before Sallah and tells his apprentice Gide what the colours signify and how riders once broke sieges of the walled city; on the hot Durbar day the crowds pack the streets, the horsemen ring the emir and charge past in the blink of an eye, one of them on the saddle Gide mended.
lessons.text:
Malam Jibo baduku ne a cikin birnin Kano. Sana'arsa ita ce ɗinkin sirdi da sauran kayan doki da fata. Tun zamanin kakan kakansa, gidansu yake hidimtawa fadar sarki: su ne suke ɗinka sirdin mahayan sarki. Malam Jibo yakan ce, "Hidimtawa fada ba aiki ba ne kawai; gado ne."

Kwanaki goma kafin Sallah, ƙofar shagonsa ta cika da sirdi. Kowane mahayi ya kawo sirdinsa domin a gyara shi kafin Hawan Sallah. Wani sirdi fatarsa ta yage, wani adonsa ya ɓace, wani kuma yana buƙatar sabuwar fata gaba ɗaya. Yaron da yake koyo a wurinsa, Gide, ɗan shekara goma sha bakwai, yana taimaka masa, yana yanka fata yana jiƙa ta.

Wata rana Gide ya tambaye shi, "Malam, me ya sa kowane sirdi yake da launuka daban daban?" Malam Jibo ya ɗauki wani sirdi ja da kore, ya ce, "Kowane launi yana alamta wani abu. A al'adarmu, ja yana alamta jarumta, kore yana alamta zaman lafiya, fari kuma yana alamta tsarki. Idan ka ga sirdi, za ka iya gane matsayin mahayinsa."

Sai ya ba shi labarin tarihi. "A da, Kano kagara ce mai ganuwa mai ƙarfi. Duk lokacin da maƙiya suka zo suka yi wa kagarar ƙawanya, mahayan sarki ne suke fita ta ƙofofin ganuwa su kore su. Shi ya sa doki da sirdi suke da daraja a wurinmu. Ganuwar kagarar ta rushe a wurare da yawa yanzu, amma tana nan a wasu wurare."

Ranar Sallah ta zo da zazzafar rana. Tun safe mutane suka fito suka cunkushe a gefen titunan da ke kaiwa fada. Yara sun hau kan bango, mata sun tsaya a ƙofofin gidaje. Gide ya sha wahala kafin ya samu wuri, domin jama'a sun cunkushe kamar tururuwa. Ya kuma ji ƙishirwa saboda zazzafar rana.

Da sarki ya fito a kan dokinsa, mahayan suka yi masa ƙawanya, suka kewaye shi ta kowane gefe, kamar yadda kakanninsu suke yi a lokacin yaƙi. Sannan rukunin mahaya ɗaya bayan ɗaya suka fara gudu zuwa gaban sarki, suna ɗaga takubbansu. Cikin ƙiftawar ido suke iso gaban sarki, su tsaya cak, sannan su juya. Gide ya ga sirdin da ya gyara da hannunsa a kan wani farin doki, kuma zuciyarsa ta cika da farin ciki. Kafin ya nuna wa kowa, dokin ya wuce shi cikin ƙiftawar ido.

Da yamma, Malam Jibo ya tambaye shi, "Ka ga sirdinka?" Gide ya ce, "Na gan shi, Malam. Yanzu na gane abin da kake nufi da cewa hidimtawa fada gado ne."

Tambayoyi:
Wace sana'a Malam Jibo yake yi?
Sana'arsa ita ce ɗinkin sirdi da sauran kayan doki da fata.
Me ya sa mahaya suka kawo sirdinsu kafin Sallah?
Domin a gyara su kafin Hawan Sallah.
Me launin kore yake alamta a cewar Malam Jibo?
Kore yana alamta zaman lafiya.
Me mahayan sarki suke yi a da idan maƙiya suka yi wa kagarar ƙawanya?
Suna fita ta ƙofofin ganuwa su kore su.
Me ya sa Gide ya sha wahala kafin ya samu wuri?
Domin jama'a sun cunkushe a gefen titunan da ke kaiwa fada.

lessons.title: Furar Mairo
lessons.summary: Near Gombe, Mairo makes fura: she buys millet by the measure at rising prices, pounds off the husks for her goats, and rolls the balls; her inherited calabash leaks, so she buys a new one; her neighbour Laure keeps her milk cold in a solar fridge; a young man who asked for bread prefers her fura; she gives a pauper fura free every day and thanks God in the evening.
lessons.text:
Mairo Bafulatana ce, kuma tana zaune a wani ƙauye a wajen garin Gombe. Mijinta yana kiwon shanu, ita kuma sana'arta ita ce yin fura da sayar da ita tare da nono. Fura abinci ne da ake yi da gero: ana daka geron, a dafa shi, a yi ƙwallaye da shi, sannan a kwaɓa shi da nono a sha.

Kowane mako, Mairo takan je kasuwa ta sayi gero da mudu. Mai sayar da hatsi yakan auna mata mudu goma a cikin buhu. A bana farashin mudu ya tashi sosai; kuɗin mudu ɗaya ya kusa ninka na bara.

Da ta koma gida, ta fara aiki. Ta zuba geron a turmi, ta yi ta daka shi da ɗan ruwa domin kwasfarsa ta fita. Sannan ta fitar da kwasfar, ta tara ta a gefe guda domin awakinta, domin suna son kwasfar gero sosai. Daga nan ta niƙa geron, ta haɗa shi da citta, ta dafa shi, ta sake daka shi har ya yi laushi, sannan ta yi ƙwallayen fura masu kyau.

Matsalar Mairo a wannan mako ita ce ƙwaryarta. Babbar ƙwarya ce da ta gada daga wurin mahaifiyarta, amma ta tsage a ƙasa, kuma tana yoyo. Duk lokacin da ta zuba nono a cikinta, sai yoyon ya fara, nono yana zuba a kan hanya. A ƙarshe ta sayi sabuwar ƙwarya.

Maƙwabciyarta, Laure, tana da firiji mai aiki da hasken rana. Kowane dare, Mairo takan kai nononta gidan Laure, a saka shi a cikin firiji. Da safe nonon yana fitowa da sanyi, kuma masu saye suna son fura mai sanyi a lokacin zafi.

Mairo takan zauna a bakin titi a ƙarƙashin wata bishiya. Wata rana wani saurayi daga birni ya tsaya ya tambaye ta, "Hajiya, kina da gurasa? Ina jin yunwa." Ta ce, "Ba ni da gurasa, sai fura. Gwada ta." Ya sha kwano ɗaya, sannan ya ce, "Wallahi wannan ta fi gurasa! Ba zan ƙara neman gurasa a wannan hanya ba."

Akwai kuma wani tsoho faƙiri da yake zuwa wurinta kowace rana da rana tsaka. Ba shi da kuɗi, ba shi da 'ya'ya a garin. Mairo ba ta taɓa karɓar kuɗi a wurinsa ba. Takan ba shi kwano ɗaya, ta ce, "Baba, ka sha lafiya." Mijinta ya taɓa tambayarta, "Kina ba faƙiri fura kowace rana, ba kya asara?" Ta ce, "Abin da na ba faƙiri ba asara ba ne. Allah yana gani."

Da yamma, Mairo ta ƙirga kuɗinta a gida. Ta sayar da fura duka, kuma ta samu riba fiye da makon jiya. Ta ɗaga hannayenta sama ta yi hamdala. Mijinta ya ce, "Kullum kina hamdala, ko an samu ko ba a samu ba." Ta ce, "Ai hamdala ce take kawo ƙari."

Tambayoyi:
Da me ake yin fura?
Ana yin fura da gero.
Da me Mairo take sayen gero?
Takan sayi gero da mudu a kasuwa.
Me Mairo take yi da kwasfar gero?
Takan tara ta domin awakinta.
Me ya sa Mairo ta sayi sabuwar ƙwarya?
Domin tsohuwar ƙwaryarta ta tsage a ƙasa, tana yoyo.
Me ya sa Mairo take kai nononta gidan Laure?
Domin a saka shi a cikin firiji, ya fito da sanyi da safe.
Me Mairo ta faɗa wa mijinta game da faƙirin?
Ta ce abin da ta ba faƙiri ba asara ba ne, Allah yana gani.

lessons.title: Boka mai tausa
lessons.summary: Near Yola, the herbalist Malam Ɗangambo massages Sadau's hurt foot in his old hut full of bats; news comes that a fake healer sold eye drops made from snail slime and the farmer Ɗanmaliki went blind; angry youths find only bats in the fake healer's hut, the elders condemn him, and Ɗangambo pays a sympathy visit and tells everyone to take eye trouble to hospital.
lessons.text:
Malam Ɗangambo boka ne a wani ƙauye kusa da Yola. Shi ba boka mai tsafi ba ne; boka ne mai maganin gargajiya, wanda ya san itatuwa da ganyaye, kuma ya iya tausa. Idan wani ya karye ko ya ji ciwo a ƙafa, wurinsa ake kai shi.

Wata safiya, wani saurayi mai suna Sadau ya zo wurinsa. Ya faɗi daga kan babur, ƙafarsa ta ji ciwo. Malam Ɗangambo ya zaunar da shi, ya shafa masa man shanu mai ɗumi, ya fara tausa a hankali. Tausar ta yi masa zafi da farko, har Sadau ya yi ihu, amma bayan minti goma ya ji sauƙi. Malam Ɗangambo ya ce, "Ka dawo gobe, mu ƙara yin tausa."

Bukkar Malam Ɗangambo tsohuwa ce, kuma a cikin rufinta akwai jemage da yawa. Sadau ya ji tsoronsu, amma Malam Ɗangambo ya ce, "Kada ka ji tsoron jemage. Ba sa cutar da kowa, sai dai kada ka taɓa su, domin wasu jemage suna ɗauke da cututtuka."

Yayin da yake tausa, wani mutum ya shigo da labari mara daɗi. Wani boka na ƙarya ya zo ƙauyen da ke maƙwabtaka da su. Ya ce yana da maganin ido da aka yi da ruwan katantanwa da ganyen daji. Wani manomi mai suna Malam Ɗanmaliki ya saka maganin a idanunsa, domin idanunsa suna ɗan yi masa ciwo. Bayan kwana biyu, idanunsa suka kumbura, kuma a ƙarshe ya makance gaba ɗaya.

Labarin ya tayar da hankalin mutane. Fusatattun matasa suka nufi bukkar bokan ƙarya da sanduna. Amma da suka isa, ba su same shi ba; ya gudu da dare. Abin da suka gani a bukkar kawai shi ne kwalabe na ruwan katantanwa, da wasu jemage da suka tashi daga rufi.

Dattawan ƙauyen suka taru a fadar mai gari, suka la'anci bokan ƙarya a gaban jama'a, kuma suka ce kada a ƙara barin baƙo ya sayar da magani a ƙauyen ba tare da izinin mai gari ba. Wani dattijo ya ce, "Mun la'anci mutumin nan, amma hakan ba zai dawo wa Ɗanmaliki da idonsa ba."

Washegari Malam Ɗangambo ya tafi gidan Malam Ɗanmaliki domin yi masa jaje. Ya ce, "Allah ya ba ku haƙuri. Na zo ne domin jaje." Matar Ɗanmaliki ta ce, "Mun gode da jajenka. Amma mijina ya makance, kuma shi ne yake ciyar da mu."

Mutane da yawa suka zo jaje, har da wasu daga cikin fusatattun matasan. Malam Ɗangambo ya ce musu, "Akwai abin da boka zai iya yi, akwai kuma abin da ba zai iya ba. Ni ina tausa, ina ba da maganin ciwon ciki. Amma ido, a'a. Duk wanda idonsa yake ciwo, ya je asibiti." Sannan suka tara kuɗi, aka kai Ɗanmaliki asibitin ido a Yola. Likita ya ce ɗaya daga cikin idanunsa yana iya warkewa.

Tambayoyi:
Wane irin boka ne Malam Ɗangambo?
Boka ne mai maganin gargajiya, wanda ya san itatuwa da ganyaye, kuma ya iya tausa.
Da me bokan ƙarya ya yi maganin ido?
Ya yi shi da ruwan katantanwa da ganyen daji.
Me ya faru da Malam Ɗanmaliki bayan ya saka maganin?
Idanunsa suka kumbura, kuma a ƙarshe ya makance gaba ɗaya.
Me fusatattun matasa suka gani a bukkar bokan ƙarya?
Sun ga kwalabe na ruwan katantanwa da wasu jemage da suka tashi daga rufi.
Me ya sa Malam Ɗangambo ya tafi gidan Ɗanmaliki?
Ya tafi domin yi masa jaje.

lessons.title: Allon Gwani Mudi
lessons.summary: In Sokoto, the Qur'anic teacher Gwani Mudi carves his pupils' boards and makes their ink and reed pens; the pupils memorise verse after verse; he lives a life of renunciation, leads remembrance at night and takes them to the tomb of Shehu Usmanu; when the new pupil Bashari repeats a man's talk of hell and idolaters, he explains who the idolaters were, warns against declaring fellow Muslims unbelievers and teaches trust in God.
lessons.text:
Gwani Mudi malami ne na makarantar allo a Sokoto, kuma ya shafe shekaru arba'in yana koyar da yara karatun Alƙur'ani. Allo wani faifai ne na katako da ake rubutu a kansa da tawada.

Gwani Mudi ba malami kaɗai ba ne; shi ma ɗan sana'a ne. Shi da kansa yake sassaƙa allunan ɗalibansa daga itace mai ƙarfi. Shi ne yake yin tawada da baƙin hayaƙi da ruwa, kuma shi ne yake yanke alƙalami daga ciyawa mai ƙarfi. Yakan ce, "Abin da ka yi da hannunka, za ka fi daraja shi."

Hanyar karatun ita ce: ɗalibi ya rubuta aya a kan allonsa, ya karanta ta da babbar murya sau da yawa har ya haddace ta, sannan ya wanke allon ya rubuta wata. Babban ɗalibinsa, Tukur, ya haddace Alƙur'ani gaba ɗaya yana da shekara goma sha biyar. Wani sabon ɗalibi, Bashari, ya fara haddace gajerun surori, kuma kowace rana yakan haddace aya uku.

Gwani Mudi yana rayuwa ta zuhudu. Ba shi da mota, ba shi da babban gida, kuma yana cin abinci sau biyu kawai a rana. Yakan ce, "Zuhudu ba yana nufin mutum ya ƙi duniya ba ne; yana nufin kada duniya ta mallake shi."

Kowane mako, da dare, ɗalibai sukan zauna da'ira suna zikiri tare da shi. Muryoyinsu suna tashi a hankali cikin duhun dare. Bashari ya tambayi Tukur, "Me ya sa muke zikiri?" Tukur ya ce, "In ji Malam, zikiri yana sa zuciya ta natsu."

Wata rana Gwani Mudi ya kai ɗalibansa ziyara zuwa hubbaren Shehu Usmanu ɗan Fodiyo. Da suka isa hubbaren, ya zaunar da su a waje, ya ba su labarin rayuwar Shehu, malami kuma marubuci wanda ya rubuta littattafai da yawa. Ya ce, "Mutane suna zuwa hubbaren nan daga ko'ina domin yin addu'a, amma ku sani, ga Allah ake addu'a, ba ga kabari ba."

A hanyarsu ta komawa, Bashari ya yi tambaya: "Malam, wani mutum a kasuwa ya ce duk wanda ba ya bin ra'ayinsa zai shiga jahannama, kuma ya kira wasu Musulmi mushirikai." Gwani Mudi ya tsaya. Ya ce, "Ɗana, mushiriki shi ne wanda yake bauta wa gumaka tare da Allah, kamar mushirikai na Makka a zamanin Annabi. Ba aikinmu ba ne mu kafirta wani Musulmi saboda saɓanin ra'ayi. Duk wanda ya kafirta ɗan uwansa ba tare da hujja ba, ya yi babban kuskure. Maganar wa zai shiga jahannama kuma, a bar wa Allah; shi ne mai hukunci."

Ya ci gaba: "Kada ku riƙa tsoratar da mutane da jahannama kawai. Ku nuna musu rahamar Allah, ku koya musu tawakkali. Tawakkali shi ne mutum ya yi iya ƙoƙarinsa, sannan ya bar sakamakon ga Allah." Ya tuna musu lokacin da ruwan sama ya rushe rufin ɗakinsa a bara. Bai yi kuka ba; ya gyara abin da zai iya gyarawa, ya ce, "Tawakkali ga Allah."

Tambayoyi:
Ta yaya ɗalibai suke haddace aya?
Suna rubuta ta a kan allo, su karanta ta da babbar murya sau da yawa har su haddace ta.
Me zuhudu yake nufi a wurin Gwani Mudi?
Yana nufin kada duniya ta mallaki mutum.
Ina Gwani Mudi ya kai ɗalibansa ziyara?
Ya kai su ziyara zuwa hubbaren Shehu Usmanu ɗan Fodiyo.
Wane ne mushiriki a cewar Gwani Mudi?
Mushiriki shi ne wanda yake bauta wa gumaka tare da Allah.
Me ake nufi da tawakkali?
Tawakkali shi ne mutum ya yi iya ƙoƙarinsa, sannan ya bar sakamakon ga Allah.

lessons.title: Shahon Ɗandaudu
lessons.summary: Near Gusau, the hunter Ɗandaudu hunts with a trained hawk instead of his father's old gun and its bullets; his son Shafi'u, a secondary-school pupil, has seen a film show on how wildlife is shot out, and Ɗandaudu backs the ban the government has imposed; camping in a tent, they ride out a night of thunder, and in the morning the hawk takes a rabbit while they spare a pregnant antelope.
lessons.text:
Ɗandaudu maharbi ne a wani ƙauye kusa da Gusau, kuma yana da shaho da ya horar tun yana ƙarami. Shaho tsuntsu ne mai farauta mai kaifin gani; daga can sama yana iya ganin zomo a cikin ciyawa. Kowace safiya Ɗandaudu yakan sa safar hannu ta fata, ya ɗora shahon a kan hannunsa, sannan su tafi daji.

Kakansa da mahaifinsa duk maharba ne, amma su da bindiga suke farauta. Bindigar mahaifinsa ta gargajiya ce, wadda masu ƙira na ƙauye suka ƙera, kuma yakan ajiye alburusai a cikin wata 'yar jaka ta fata. Mahaifinsa yakan bindige barewa daga nesa ba tare da ya rasa ba. Amma Ɗandaudu ya fi son shaho. Yakan ce, "Shaho ba ya amo kamar bindiga, ba ya buƙatar alburusai, kuma ba ya tsorata dukan dajin."

Ɗan Ɗandaudu, Shafi'u, yana aji na uku a makarantar sakandari a Gusau. Wata rana malamansu suka kafa majigi a filin makarantar da dare, suka nuna musu wani fim game da dabbobin daji. Fim ɗin ya nuna yadda dabbobi suka ragu a daji saboda mutane suna bindige su ba tare da tunani ba. Da Shafi'u ya dawo gida a ƙarshen mako, ya ba mahaifinsa labarin majigin da suka kalla a sakandari.

Ɗandaudu ya saurara, sannan ya ce, "Gaskiya ne. Shi ya sa gwamnati ta ƙaƙaba doka a bana: an hana farauta a cikin dajin gwamnati a lokacin damina, lokacin da dabbobi suke haihuwa. Wasu maharba sun yi ƙorafi, suka ce gwamnati ta ƙaƙaba musu doka ba tare da shawara ba. Amma ni na yarda da dokar."

Washegari, Ɗandaudu ya ɗauki Shafi'u zuwa farauta a wajen dajin gwamnati. Suka yi tafiya mai nisa, kuma da yamma suka kafa ƙaramin tanti a gefen wani dutse.

Da dare ya yi, sai iska ta taso, walƙiya ta fara haskawa. Aradu ta yi ruri da ƙarfi har ƙasa ta girgiza. Shahon ya fara firgita yana kaɗa fikafikansa a cikin tantin. Ɗandaudu ya rufe shi da ɗan zane, ya ce, "Kwantar da hankalinka, aradu ba za ta cutar da kai ba." Shafi'u ma ya ji tsoron aradu, amma bai faɗa ba. Ruwan sama ya yi ta bugun tantin har asuba, amma tantin bai yage ba.

Da safe, sama ta yi tsabta. Ɗandaudu ya saki shahon. Shahon ya tashi sama ya yi zagaye, sannan cikin sauri ya sauko kamar dutse ya kama wani zomo a cikin ciyawa. Daga baya suka ga wata barewa mai ciki tana kiwo a gefen rafi. Shafi'u ya ce, "Baba, da kakana yana nan, da ya bindige ta." Ɗandaudu ya yi murmushi, ya ce, "Kuma da ya yi kuskure. Mu bar ta ta haihu."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Ɗandaudu ya fi son shaho a kan bindiga?
Domin shaho ba ya amo kamar bindiga, ba ya buƙatar alburusai, kuma ba ya tsorata dajin.
Ina Shafi'u yake karatu?
Yana aji na uku a makarantar sakandari a Gusau.
Me fim ɗin majigin ya nuna?
Ya nuna yadda dabbobi suka ragu saboda mutane suna bindige su ba tare da tunani ba.
Wace doka gwamnati ta ƙaƙaba a bana?
Ta hana farauta a cikin dajin gwamnati a lokacin damina.
Me ya faru da dare a cikin tantin?
Aradu ta yi ruri, shahon ya firgita, kuma ruwan sama ya yi ta bugun tantin har asuba.

lessons.title: Murjanin amarya
lessons.summary: Lantana sells coral jewellery from her shop at a crossroads in the Maiduguri market; she explains that coral is by nature built by sea creatures; a bride chooses a coral necklace as her bride price, and Lantana shows how plastic imitations betray themselves; her former apprentice Kolomi repays her with ingratitude; she judges a bead competition at a crafts fair where a minister talks of trillions of naira, and Kolomi comes to apologise.
lessons.text:
Lantana tana da shago a mahaɗin manyan tituna biyu a kasuwar Maiduguri. Sana'arta ita ce haɗa kayan ado na murjani: sarƙoƙi, mundaye da 'yan kunne. Idan baƙo ya tambayi hanya, sai a ce masa, "Idan ka isa mahaɗin titunan, ka duba hagu, za ka ga shagon Lantana."

Amare suna sa murjani a ranar aurensu, kuma tsofaffin mata suna ajiye sarƙar murjani a matsayin dukiya. Lantana takan faɗa wa masu saye cewa murjani ba dutse ba ne. "A ɗabi'ance," in ji ta, "murjani abu ne da wasu ƙananan halittun teku suke ginawa a ƙarƙashin ruwa, cikin shekaru masu yawa. Shi ya sa yake da tsada."

Wata safiya, wata uwa ta zo tare da 'yarta Rukaiya, wadda za a yi wa aure. Uwar ta ce, "Angon ya ce sadakinta zai haɗa da sarƙar murjani. Mun zo mu zaɓa da kanmu." Lantana ta fito da sarƙoƙi guda biyar. Rukaiya ta zaɓi wata mai jan launi mai haske. "Wannan ce za ta zama sadakina," in ji ta tana murmushi.

Sai uwar ta ce, "A kasuwa ana sayar da murjani da arha sosai. Ta yaya za mu gane na gaske?" Lantana ta ce, "Akwai roba da ake shigo da ita daga waje, wadda aka ƙera domin ta kwaikwayi murjani. Ta kwaikwayi launinsa, amma ba ta iya kwaikwayi nauyinsa ba. A ɗabi'ance, murjani na gaske yana da nauyi kuma yana da sanyi a hannu. Kuma idan ka kunna ashana kusa da roba, sai ta narke ta yi wari."

Wata matsala da Lantana ta fuskanta a bana ita ce butulcin tsohon yaronta, Kolomi. Ta koya masa sana'ar tsawon shekaru bakwai. Da ya gama koyo, sai ya buɗe shago a daidai mahaɗin titunan, kusa da nata, yana sayar da murjanin roba, kuma yana gaya wa masu saye cewa murjanin Lantana ba na gaske ba ne. Ita kuwa ta ce, "Butulci ba ya hana rana fitowa. Gaskiya za ta bayyana."

A watan da ya wuce, aka yi bikin baje kolin sana'o'in hannu a Maiduguri, kuma gwamnati ta gayyaci Lantana domin ta yi alƙalanci a gasar masu haɗa kayan ado. An zaɓe ta ne saboda gaskiyarta. A lokacin alƙalanci, ta auna kowace sarƙa a hannu.

A wurin bikin, wani minista ya yi jawabi. Ya ce idan aka tallafa wa masu sana'o'in hannu, za su iya kawo wa ƙasar naira tiriliyan uku a kowace shekara. Lantana ta yi dariya, ta ce wa maƙwabciyarta, "Ni ban san yawan tiriliyan ba, amma na san yawan aikin da ke cikin sarƙa ɗaya."

Bayan bikin, Kolomi ya zo shagonta da kunya. Ya ce, "Na yi miki butulci. Ki yafe mini." Ta yafe masa, kuma ta ce masa ya fara sayar da murjani na gaske.

Tambayoyi:
Me murjani yake a ɗabi'ance, a cewar Lantana?
Abu ne da wasu ƙananan halittun teku suke ginawa a ƙarƙashin ruwa.
Me Rukaiya ta zaɓa a matsayin sadakinta?
Ta zaɓi sarƙar murjani mai jan launi mai haske.
Ta yaya za a gane roba da aka ƙera domin ta kwaikwayi murjani?
Murjani na gaske yana da nauyi da sanyi a hannu, kuma roba tana narkewa idan aka kunna ashana kusa da ita.
Wane butulci ne Kolomi ya yi?
Ya buɗe shago kusa da nata, yana gaya wa masu saye cewa murjaninta ba na gaske ba ne.
Me ya sa gwamnati ta zaɓi Lantana domin alƙalanci?
An zaɓe ta ne saboda gaskiyarta.
